channel.title: Mavy EduSolutions Blog
channel.description: Notes on shipping global product — localization, AI data, education solutions, and engineering from the Mavy EduSolutions team.

item.title: Why "good enough" machine translation still needs a human pass
item.description: MT gets you a fast first draft. Here's where it quietly breaks — idiom, tone, and anything with legal weight — and why a second linguist still has to catch it.

item.title: RLHF data quality: what "high agreement" actually measures
item.description: Inter-rater agreement is easy to game and easy to misread. What it tells you about your preference data, and what it doesn't.

item.title: Shipping right-to-left layouts without a second sprint
item.description: The layout bugs that only show up in Arabic and Hebrew builds, and how to catch them in QA instead of in a support ticket.

item.title: Sourcing wake-word audio across 40 languages without burning your timeline
item.description: What actually slows down multilingual voice data collection — and it usually isn't the recording.

item.title: What a translation memory actually saves you
item.description: Not just money on repeated strings — consistency across releases, and a paper trail when a term changes six months in.

item.title: A glossary is a contract: keeping terms consistent across 40 languages
item.description: How one unreviewed term change turns into forty inconsistent ones, and the review step that stops it.

item.title: Why multilingual SEO is more than translating your keywords
item.description: Hreflang tags, locale-specific search intent, and the gap between "translated" and "discoverable" in 12 markets.

item.title: Red-teaming your LLM: what annotators actually look for
item.description: A practical breakdown of the failure modes human raters flag — and why "sounds correct" is the hardest category to evaluate.

item.title: Localizing e-learning for cultural learning styles, not just language
item.description: Why a translated course isn't a localized course — and the structural changes that make assessments work in MENA, LATAM, and APAC markets.

item.title: Why SCORM compliance breaks during translation — and how to prevent it
item.description: The packaging failures that only surface after you upload to the LMS, and the QA step that catches them before that.

item.title: Building AI tutoring datasets that actually improve student outcomes
item.description: What separates useful Q&A training pairs from noise — difficulty calibration, pedagogical intent tagging, and subject-area coverage.

item.title: Pseudo-localization: catching layout bugs before your linguists do
item.description: How synthetic placeholder text with accents and extended characters reveals truncation and overflow issues in your UI before real translation begins.

item.title: Curating Multimodal Datasets for Vision-Language Models: Image-Text Pairing at Scale
item.description: High-quality image-text alignment for VLM fine-tuning. How synthetic captioning, bounding box verification, and OCR extraction prevent hallucination.

item.title: Evaluating LLM Translation Quality: COMET, BLEU, and Human Rating Correlation
item.description: Why traditional BLEU scores fail to capture semantic nuance in modern LLM translations, and how COMET metrics paired with MQM human evaluation set the gold standard.

item.title: Designing Adaptive Learning Engines: Item Response Theory (IRT) in Modern EdTech
item.description: How 3PL Item Response Theory and knowledge tracing algorithms dynamically adjust question difficulty for personalized student learning pathways.

item.title: Zero-Shot Multilingual Voice Cloning: Dataset Requirements & Phoneme Alignment
item.description: What makes voice cloning sound natural across language boundaries — IPA phoneme mapping, studio-quality noise floor, and cross-lingual prosody transfer.

item.title: Chunking Strategies for Multilingual RAG: Retaining Semantic Context Across Languages
item.description: Why fixed-length character chunking breaks cross-lingual vector retrieval, and how sentence-boundary awareness and metadata enrichment boost RAG accuracy.

item.title: Building an Enterprise LQA Framework: DQF-MQM Error Typology in Practice
item.description: Standardizing localization quality audit scoring across 40 vendors with DQF-MQM severity weighting and automated quality gates.
